method: Self-authored QualifyNativeEmbedding run explicitly through native Macro dialog. Creates a separate workbook, inserts owned embedded-source.xlsx via OLEObjects.Add, saves plain XLS and CryptoAPI password-to-open XLS. Native output workbook has no macro project. No application security settings changed.

encryptionProfile.encryptedEntries: one embedding storage; no document-property descriptors
encryptionProfile.nativeMirror: same class/state and stream bytes outside encrypted container; root timestamps differ

limits: Native-producer encrypted document properties are not qualified by this cohort. Both the explicit-provider and properties-only option calls returned error 5 (Invalid procedure call or argument); saved property streams are plaintext.
This qualifies an embedded XLSX package, not arbitrary OLE activation, links, ActiveX or every embedded server.
Stored marker and successful native SaveAs prove execution of the self-authored controller only.

nativeConsumer.operation: OfficeIMO LoadEncrypted; add A2=Edited native embedding; replace B1 with formula 40+2 while retaining its native XF; save plain XLS and classic-RC4 XLS using new-password. Open each exact output in Excel without repair prompts, F9, SaveAs separate readback.
nativeConsumer.observed: Both opened without repair/file-error prompts. Public API readbacks retain A2, B1=42, B3=50, exact title/subject and the embedded XLSX marker/42.
nativeConsumer.limits: Accessibility observations and artifact readback; rendered geometry and embedded-server activation were not inspected.

protectedOutputQualification.operation: Import native encrypted source; plain snapshot, cell/formula edits, SaveEncrypted using new-password retaining CryptoAPI and encrypted-only MBD. Exact output opened without repair in native Excel, active sheet recalculated and SaveAs readback verified through public API.
protectedOutputQualification.beforeNative: FilePass4.2; one encrypted storage descriptor; no clear MBD/Package streams; title/subject intentionally plaintext in source profile.
protectedOutputQualification.verified: A2 exact edit, B1=42, B3=50, exact title/subject, embedded marker/42. Native readback may recreate a clear mirror.
